Aura Condominium

Condominium in Rawai (near Chalong)
HomeSaleAura Condominium

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Aura Condominium is an off-plan condominium of 241 units in 2 buildings of 7 floors, listed by FazWaz in Rawai but sited close to the Chalong roundabout in southern Phuket. Completion is scheduled for June 2027. Studios start at about 29 sqm, followed by one-bedroom units of about 37 sqm, two-bedroom units of about 50 to 59 sqm and three-bedroom units of about 96 sqm.

Listed facilities are a communal pool, spa, communal garden, communal gym, an on-site restaurant, parking at one space per unit and 24-hour security. Common-area fees are listed at THB 60 per sqm per month with a sinking fund of THB 800. Pets are not allowed.

This is a Chalong-side location rather than a beachfront one: the Chalong roundabout is about 0.9 km away, Villa Market Chalong 1.2 km and Chalong Pier 1.4 km (straight line), with BCIS Phuket International School about 3.6 km and Dibuk Hospital about 8.2 km. Prices are advertised on the portal from about THB 2.9 million to 11.2 million; confirm current availability with us.
